first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A dark gray-black handgun in a first-person view, initially raised and tilted, then lowered to the lower right of the image.

entities.name: Object A
entities.identification: A creature-like body on the floor behind the door, initially with a light-colored central portion and brown upward-extending limb-like parts, then changing to a sprawled posture.

entities.name: group of metal barrels
entities.identification: A collection of turquoise-green barrel-shaped props against the wall on the left behind the door; the exposed barrel bodies have horizontal bands.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: Large rectangular wall panels indoors, light gray to blue-gray, with rivets arranged near the seams.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: A gray to turquoise-green paneled floor indoors, with panel seams and a raised step in front of the door.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: A dark-colored ceiling surface above the passage behind the door, with multiple parallel trim strips along the wall-ceiling junction.

entities.name: yellow hazard sign
entities.identification: A yellow triangular sign with a black border on the wall beside the door, with a black skull-and-crossbones pattern on its face.

entities.name: dark-colored doorframe
entities.identification: The dark-colored border of the doorway to the left of the yellow hazard sign, with light gray edging strips.
